title: The Swallows Come Home

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: Look up! The swallows are back from the south, after all those months away. They've flown across the sea!

intro.speaker: finn
intro.text: They nest in pairs under my roof. Would you help me count them in? Two in each nest.

steps.speaker: finn
steps.prompt: Put two swallows in each nest. Count in twos!
steps.hint: Find a nest with an empty dip, and put a swallow there.

older.prompt: Two swallows in each nest, eight nests. Count in twos: two, four, six...

feedback.full: That nest has its pair. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Two, four, six, eight, ten! Five pairs of swallows, home again.

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: Ten swallows! Do you remember, at the start of winter, sorting out who flew away? Here they are, back home.

journal_line: I counted the swallows coming home, in twos, with Mr. Finn.

outro.speaker: finn
outro.text: Sixteen swallows: eight pairs! And they flew all the way across the sea to get here.
